# Third-party components

The skills in `.claude/skills/` are copied unmodified from the projects below. Each remains under its original license; full texts are in `third_party/licenses/`.

| Component | Skills | Source | Snapshot | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UI/UX Pro Max | banner-design, brand, design, design-system, slides, ui-styling, ui-ux-pro-max | https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill | 56ea9cf (2026-10-15) | MIT |
| HyperFrames | hyperframes*, embedded-captions, faceless-explainer, figma, general-video, media-use, motion-graphics, music-to-video, pr-to-video, product-launch-video, remotion-to-hyperframes, slideshow, talking-head-recut | https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes | 4d6b5be (2026-10-16) | Apache-2.0 |
| HeyGen skills | heygen-avatar, heygen-video, heygen-translate | https://github.com/heygen-com/skills | 1bd5e4d (2026-07-14) | MIT |
| Remotion skills | remotion-* | https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills | 1441a11 (2026-10-16) | Remotion License — free for individuals and for-profit organizations with up to 3 employees; larger companies need a Company License (https://www.remotion.dev/license) |
| Vazirmatn font | brand/fonts | https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn | latest | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| GSAP 3.14.2 | videos/myticket-punch/assets/gsap.min.js | https://gsap.com | 3.14.2 | GSAP Standard "no charge" License (https://gsap.com/standard-license) |
| three.js 0.181.2 | videos/myticket-unexpected-3d/assets/three | https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js | 0.181.2 | MIT (LICENSE included in folder) |

OpenMontage (https://github.com/calesthio/OpenMontage, AGPL-3.0) is not included; `scripts/get-openmontage.sh` downloads it on demand.

To update a component, re-copy its skills from the source repository and update the snapshot column.
